contentReview.alternativesAndQuality: See rationale; all four alternatives examined. No exact duplicated option labels in item.
contentReview.requiredAction: Proposed only: specify continuing study up to now and review all distractors; approve revised immutable version before scoring.

contentReview.individualKeyRationale: B is the intended past-condition/present-result mixed conditional. C can express a counterfactual result already realized by a point earlier today; today alone leaves a temporal-reading issue for adjudication.
